stories.story_fr: Casey's a réalisé une année fiscale record en 2025 avec un bénéfice net de 546,5 M$ et un EBITDA de 1,2 M$.
stories.story_en: Casey's delivered another record fiscal year in 2025, reaching $546.5 million of net income and $1.2 billion in EBITDA.
stories.quote: Casey's delivered another record fiscal year as our team continued to execute on our three-year strategic plan, reaching $546.5 million of net income and $1.2 billion in EBITDA.

stories.story_fr: Casey's a été ajouté à l'indice S&P 500 en 2026, reconnaissant sa performance financière constante.
stories.story_en: Casey's was added to the S&P 500 Index in 2026 in recognition of its consistent financial performance.
stories.quote: Casey's was added to the S&P 500 Index in recognition of its consistent financial performance and the growth of the company.

stories.story_fr: En 2026, la marge carburant a atteint 46,9 cents/gal, soutenue par une hausse de 21 % du profit brut du carburant.
stories.story_en: In 2026, the fuel margin rose to 46.9 cents per gallon, backed by a 21 % increase in fuel gross profit.
stories.quote: Our fuel team did a great job balancing gallons sold with fuel margin, as fiscal 2026 fuel gross profit increased 21% from the prior year.

stories.story_fr: Le programme Rewards a atteint près de 10,5 millions de membres à la fin de 2026.
stories.story_en: The Rewards program grew to nearly 10.5 million members by year-end 2026.
stories.quote: Casey's Rewards grew to nearly 10.5 million members by year-end.

stories.story_fr: En 2025, Casey's a réalisé son acquisition la plus importante avec Fikes Wholesale, portant le nombre total de magasins à environ 2 900.
stories.story_en: In 2025, Casey's completed its largest acquisition ever—Fikes Wholesale—bringing the total store count to roughly 2,900.
stories.quote: The Company built or acquired 270 stores in the fiscal year, the most in the Company's history. This included the Fikes Wholesale acquisition and its 198 CEFCO convenience stores.
